configurations.name: portal-exe
runtimeArgs: $ids = (Get-Process oHRganize -ErrorAction Stop).Id; $p = (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $ids -contains $_.OwningProcess } | Select-Object -First 1).LocalPort; if (-not $p) { throw 'oHRganize.exe lauscht auf keinem Port' }; Write-Host "Portal gegen eingebettetes Backend http://127.0.0.1:$p"; $env:VITE_API_BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:$p"; npm run dev -w apps/web
